79249451.baseName: 6ft 6in (1.9m) Unlit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree with 3,760 Forest Fresh Branch Tips & Simple Shape Technology
79249451.variantName: 6ft 6in (1.9m) Unlit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree with 3,760 Forest Fresh Branch Tips & Simple Shape Technology
79249451.sourceDescription:
Ring in the Christmas holidays with the 6.5 ft (2m) Unlit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree. Styling your tree is easy with the Simple Shape™ feature, as the tree springs into shape right out of the box. Other features include 3,760 Forest Fresh™ branch tips and a sturdy metal tree stand so your tree can stay upright all season. Bring this beautiful Christmas tree home today!
PREMIUM UNLIT CHRISTMAS TREE – Elegant 6ft 6in (1.9m) Aspen artificial tree with a lush, natural look, perfect for adding your own lights and decorations for a custom holiday style.
SIMPLE SHAPE™ INSTANT SETUP – Innovative Simple Shape™ technology allows the branches to spring into place straight out of the box, reducing setup time and eliminating tedious manual fluffing.
REALISTIC FOREST FRESH™ BRANCHES – Features 3,760 ultra-realistic Forest Fresh™ branch tips for a full, natural appearance that beautifully showcases ornaments and garlands.
STRONG & STABLE DESIGN – Comes with a heavy-duty metal stand and secure locking mechanism to keep your tree upright and steady throughout the festive season.
IDEAL SIZE FOR ANY ROOM – Measures 6.5ft (1.9m) tall with a 46in diameter base, making it a perfect centrepiece for living rooms, entryways, or office spaces; for indoor use only.
Guarantee - 1 year

79254851.baseName: 6.5 ft (1.98m) Pre-Lit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree with 1200 Colour Changing Micro LED Lights
79254851.variantName: 6.5 ft (1.98m) Pre-Lit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree with 1200 Colour Changing Micro LED Lights
79254851.sourceDescription:
Welcome in the festive season with this 6ft 5 Inches Pre-Lit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree. This premium and realistic artificial Christmas tree is easy to set up with the EZ Connect™ and Simple Shape™ technologies, as the tree springs into shape and lights up once tree poles are connected. Pre-strung with 1,200 colour-changing Radiant Micro LED lights with 11 effects and a dimmer option, they’re all controlled conveniently with a remote controller.
Brilliant 1200 Colour-Changing LEDs – Features 1,200 pre-strung Radiant Micro Dot LED lights with 11 dazzling light effects and 5 brightness levels, creating a magical festive ambiance in your home.
Quick & Easy Setup – The EZ Connect™ technology automatically lights the tree once the poles are connected—no messy cords or plugs required for a seamless assembly experience.
Instant Full Shape – With Simple Shape™ technology, branches open into their natural position instantly, saving time and ensuring a beautiful, full-bodied silhouette right out of the box.
Lifelike Forest Fresh™ Branch Tips – Boasts 2,966 ultra-realistic Forest Fresh™ branch tips (PE/PVC mix for texture and density) for a lush, natural look that mimics a real evergreen.
Customizable Lighting Experience – Includes a remote control with dimmer function, allowing you to switch between 11 lighting modes and adjust brightness across five levels.
Durable and Stable Base – Supported by a heavy-duty metal stand with a secure locking mechanism, ensuring your tree stays upright and steady throughout the season.
Ideal Size for Any Room – Stands 6.5 ft (1.98 m) tall with a 40-inch diameter base, making it perfect for living rooms, offices, or entryways. For indoor use only.
Guarantee - 1 year

5058194831851.sourceDescription:
Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and white finish and metal and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Metal and Plastic. Colour: Green and White. Stated size: 180 cm. Product weight: 5.7 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive green and white colour scheme adds a defined decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Durable metal and plastic construction ensures a sturdy frame for long-lasting seasonal use.
Compact footprint allows flexible placement in various home settings without visual clutter.
Easy to store and reposition, making it a convenient finishing touch for holiday arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hinged
Assembly required
With stand

0762110958151.sourceDescription:
Bring a magical glow to your holiday décor with this 124cm fiber optic Christmas tree. Crafted from pure PVC in an evergreen green finish with white light bundles, it sits on a sturdy iron stand and features 125 tips for a full, balanced shape. Cool white fiber optic lights are bound directly into the tree—no separate string lights needed—while a warm white LED star topper and 16 small star lights add a cozy sparkle. The control box offers 8 manually adjustable lighting modes, from combination and waves to twinkle and steady on. Packed in an English kraft paper box, it's compact, easy to set up, and perfect for small homes or cozy corners.
Pure PVC Evergreen – Rich green foliage with white light bundles
Fiber Optic Cool White – Lights bound into the tree, no stringing needed
Warm White LED Stars – 1 large star topper + 16 small star lights
8 Lighting Modes – Manually adjustable via control box (combination, waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on)
Iron Stand – Sturdy metal base for stable placement
124cm Compact Size – 60cm base diameter, ideal for small spaces
Kraft Paper Box – Eco-friendly English kraft packaging
Guarantee - 1 year

Create a focal point

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Care and presentation

The compact footprint allows it to fit neatly into corners or against walls without overwhelming the room layout. Its dimensions make it an excellent option for apartments or homes where floor space is limited but festive spirit is desired.

Constructed from durable plastic materials, this tree is built to withstand repeated assembly and disassembly over many years. The green colour provides a traditional aesthetic that complements various styles of baubles, lights and tinsel decorations.

5037204495351.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red. Quantity: 1 piece.
Decorative baubles with intricate detail design to enhance your festive Christmas tree display.
Hanging format allows versatile placement among branches or in coordinated seasonal arrangements.
Crafted from durable plastic material, ensuring longevity and resilience for repeated holiday use.
Vibrant red colour adds a classic festive touch, perfect for creating a focal point on your tree.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 1x Christmas Bauble
Hanger included

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Festive Father Christmas motif with intricate snowflake detailing for a classic holiday look.
Crafted from durable wood, providing a sturdy and traditional aesthetic for your seasonal display.
Versatile design allows it to serve as a focal point or complement other decorations in any arrangement.
Comes in a convenient 3-pack, offering excellent value and consistency for coordinating your Christmas decor.

8956086362551.sourceDescription:
Thirty hanging swirls is the sort of quantity that turns one doorway into a proper Christmas scene. The set brings six white snowflakes, six red reindeer, six red bells and twelve green trees, each on a foil swirl that extends to somewhere between 63 and 89 cm, with a plastic hook at the top for hanging from ceilings, windows and curtain rails.

The PVC foil is light and bright, each swirl cut flat and spinning gently when the heating kicks in, which children reliably find fascinating. The plastic hooks make hanging and repositioning a two-minute job with no tape or pins in the paintwork.

After the season they detach carefully and store flat in the decoration box, ready for the next round of ceilings, porches, windows and party rooms.

Material: PVC foil
Thirty swirls: snowflakes, reindeer, bells and trees
Each extends to roughly 63-89 cm of hanging length
Plastic hooks fix to ceilings and rails in minutes
Light PVC foil that spins gently in warm air
Stores flat for reuse every Christmas
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its green finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch

Add navy blue colour and contrasting texture to your Christmas decorations with this pack of 3 matching 10cm thread ball baubles. Each round ornament has a thread-wrapped surface with a gold sequin band around the middle, bringing together fine lines and reflective detail in one design. A hanging loop above the decorative cap provides a way to position the bauble on a suitable tree branch or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the navy blue finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Use the matching pieces to repeat the design across the tree, or combine with your own plain and patterned decorations for a varied display. These Christmas tree ornaments also work in indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery, winter wedding decorations and festive party displays. This option contains 3 baubles, with the same thread covering and sequin-band design on each piece. Display the band facing forward so its sequin detail remains visible between branches.
Thread Ball Baubles: Includes 3 matching 10cm navy blue Christmas tree baubles, with a thread-wrapped surface and a gold sequin band around the middle. The round ornaments add colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, wreaths and garlands, with the same finish on each selected piece.
Sequin Band Detail: The gold band contrasts with the navy blue thread covering, combining a textured finish with reflective sequin detail. Place these decorative Christmas balls among foliage and ribbons to add a different surface beside plain baubles in your seasonal arrangement.
Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the navy blue colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.
Display And Pack Contents: Includes 3 matching decorative balls for a repeated accent, each measuring 10cm. Add to indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery or a decorated tree, then coordinate with your own bows, foliage and seasonal accessories for a display throughout the festive season.

5313817010151.sourceDescription:
Product Description

 This festive hanging Christmas hat decoration comes in 4 distinct styles, creating a warm festive atmosphere for your home during the holiday season. 
 Made of soft fabric, this eye-catching hanging ornament is equipped with built-in LED lights and delicate hanging tassels decorated with Christmas-themed pendants.

Product Specifications

 Material: Fabric
 Size (hat body, excluding tassels): Height 30cm × Diameter 20cm
 Total assembled height (including tassels): 50cm
 Weight: 80g
 Power supply: Powered by 2 AA batteries. Batteries are NOT included.

Main Features

 4 Unique Styles AvailableChoose from 4 different Christmas hat designs: solid red classic Santa hat, red-white striped elf hat, snowflake printed red hat and other festive styles. Each style is decorated with matching pendants including stars,
 gift boxes, mini Christmas trees, baubles and snowflakes.
 Built-in LED LightingThe hat rim and hanging tassels feature warm LED lights. Once powered on, it emits soft glowing light to boost your Christmas decor. The dangling tassels with assorted holiday ornaments create a layered, elegant hanging
 visual effect.
 Lightweight & Easy to HangWeighs only 80g, simple to hang from ceilings, doorways, windows, mantels or Christmas trees. No complex installation required.
 Wide ApplicationPerfect for Christmas party decor, living room, fireplace, shop window, cafe and holiday display. Great for seasonal decoration to enrich your Christmas scene.

Important Notes

 Batteries are not included, please prepare 2 AA batteries by yourself.
 Handle carefully to protect the delicate hanging ornaments.
 Indoor use recommended.
This hanging Santa hat chandelier features a classic red hat silhouette with plush white trim and a signature belt buckle, creating a bold dimensional display that becomes the focal point of your Christmas decor.
Equipped with warm white LED fairy lights extending from the hat brim and illuminating festive charms like stars, trees, and baubles, this Christmas lighted decor produces a soft, inviting glow perfect for evening gatherings and cozy holiday ambiance.
Choose from 3 festive styles to match your holiday home decorations: a classic snowflake Santa hat, a traditional belted Santa hat, or a playful candy-cane striped wreath hat. Each style includes unique hanging ornaments for a personalized Christmas feel.
No complicated assembly required; simply suspend the piece from any suitable overhead point and reposition as needed. Use it as Christmas ceiling decoration above dining tables, fireplaces, entryways, or party tables for a fast seasonal transformation.
Designed for both indoor and covered outdoor spaces, this hanging holiday lighting decor fits front porches, covered patios, sunrooms, living rooms, fireplace mantels, or party settings. Its sturdy construction allows for years of reusable Christmas decorating.

This decorative piece is ideal for anyone looking for a simple way to brighten a room with seasonal character.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and metal and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Metal and PVC. Colour: White. Stated size: 8 m. Product weight: 0.15 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive white metal and PVC wreath designed to create a striking focal point for Christmas displays.
Versatile decorative detail suitable for coordinating with existing room colour schemes and textures.
Durable construction using specified materials to maintain shape and appearance throughout the season.
Simple modern design that adds seasonal charm without requiring complex arrangement or styling.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5096042276751.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Illuminated Christmas decoration - 35 warm white LEDs and holly for a hallway or mantel - Green, 60 cm
5096042276751.sourceDescription:
Holly-style leaves, berries and pine cones sit among 170 branch tips. Thirty-five warm white LEDs soften the 60 cm outline after dark, and the built-in timer makes it easy to bring the lights on as part of an evening routine.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

Choose the start of the lighting period with the room's usual evening routine in mind. It is worth checking the controls while the wreath is still within reach, before moving it to its final position. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct.

If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own.

8635560241451.sourceDescription:
Welcome visitors with a traditional wreath on the front door, built around realistic artificial holly and pine with the classic red and gold trimmings.

The wreath combines layered foliage: deep green pine branches with holly leaves and red berries, bright red baubles, a gold flower detail and a large ribbon bow, finished with a small Christmas sign at the centre. The mix of textures is what makes it read as a proper wreath rather than a plain green ring, and the reds and golds stand out clearly against a painted door.

At 30 cm across it is a good size for a front door, an interior door, a fireplace or a window, large enough to be seen from the path without overwhelming a narrow porch. The foliage is arranged in a full circle with no obvious gaps, and the decorations sit at different depths so the wreath has shape when viewed from an angle.

Being artificial, it keeps its colour and shape season after season and needs no watering, dropping no needles onto a doorstep. The decorations are fixed rather than loose, so the wreath survives being hung, taken down and stored in a bag.

Hang it with the loop at the back on a door hook, an over door hanger or a nail, and it sits flat against the surface. It is suitable for sheltered outdoor use as well as indoors, so it can dress a front door through December and then move inside.

The wreath is built on a firm base, so it keeps a round shape rather than flattening against a door. Because the foliage is artificial, it can hang in a porch or on an internal door without dropping needles onto a step. The sign at the centre can be left in place or removed for a plainer look, and the bow is wired so it holds its shape. Store it in a bag with the bow facing outwards so the ribbon does not crease.

Wipe the foliage with a dry cloth or a soft brush before packing it away flat. One pack contains one wreath.

Realistic Artificial Foliage: Keeps its colour and form year after year with no watering, dropping no needles and needing only a dry brush to clean

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Flexible Shaping
The flexible construction lets you arrange the decorative sections to suit the available display space. Shape the parts gently as directed to create the outline you want, whether the piece is shown alone or within a larger seasonal grouping.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Green. Stated size: 30 cm. Quantity: 8 pack.
Flexible shaping allows you to arrange decorative sections to suit your display space.

Reusable Design

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

Throughout the figurine there are flashing multicoloured LED lights, as well as a solid white light in the lantern which bathes your room in a soft warm white glow.

This figurine would help bring the festive spirit into your home this Christmas.

Requires 3 x AA batteries in total, 2 in Santa and 1 in the lantern (not included)
